name: Aihara Miki
source:
A third-year student. Vice president of the beautification committee. Famous around school for her benevolent personality.

She can't say no to a request, so she's always busy with someone else's work. Her dedication this role has earned her the nickname "Saint," but to her…

The type who wants her lover to lead her by the hand.

Strengths: Easily remembers names and faces, all school subjects
Weakness: Slight fear of heights
Hobbies: Gardening, crafts, helping people find their way, collecting accessories
Skill: Cleaning

[Taken from the [url=http://mangagamer.org/kindredspirits/]English official website[/url]]
